propositions: code_health metric is language-coupled and non-portable to non-Python client projects, blocking use of metrics framework across polyglot codebases

current metrics hardcode Python-specific paths (src/rebar/**/*.py, .github/module-size-limit.txt) and fabricate authoritative zeros or leak FileNotFoundError instead of reporting genuine Unavailable when applied to absent/unsupported languages
replace Python-only readers with configurable polyglot analyzer (scc/lizard/jscpd) backing a generic interface (analyze(repo_root, languages) -> {loc, complexity, duplication})
ship analyzer + tool dependencies as optional [metrics] extra to keep rebar core dependency-free and degrade gracefully to Unavailable when extra is absent
module-size policy (rebar CAP) must become per-project config layered on generic LOC signal instead of hardcoded governance artifact
missing or unsupported analyzer must emit honest Unavailable with clear reason, never fabricate zeros and never leak raw errno or exception string
